newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's GasAndes project refinances pipeline.
newsitem.headline: Chile's GasAndes project refinances pipeline.

text.p: The Chilean/Canadian GasAndes consortium said it has received a five-year $225 million syndicated loan to refinance its natural gas pipeline being built from Argentina to Chile.
The loan was headed by the Bank of Nova Scotia and involves a group of eight Canadian and three European banks, the consortium said in a statement.
The pipeline is being built by a group led by Chilean power generator Chilgener and Canada's NOVA Corp.
The consortium will spend $150 million of the loan on the section of the pipeline in Chile with the rest invested in Argentina, it said.
The project is 95 percent completed in Argentina with 87 percent of the Chilean stretch finished.
The pipeline, which will pump gas across the Andes to Santiago from the Argentine city of Mendoza, is due to come into operation at the end of June.
